about: The only record that decides what the public site shows. A piece is public when releasedAt (a date in Pacific/Honolulu) is today or earlier and hold is false. An empty releasedAt means not released. To release a piece, set releasedAt to its posting date, set hold to false, and add its post links under postUrls (one per platform).
